title: Introduction to Portfolio Optimization: Markowitz and Beyond
description: A rigorous, formula-first path into modern portfolio theory for quant analyst aspirants, prop trading applicants, and systematizing traders. Covers portfolio return and variance, covariance and correlation, the Markowitz efficient frontier, the Capital Market Line and its link to CAPM, and the practical extensions (Black-Litterman, risk parity, factor-based construction) that fix mean-variance optimization's real-world weaknesses. Built entirely on Nifty 50, Nifty Bank, and Nifty IT data.
